title: {Ce10Mn8}: Cerium Analogues of the Decavanadate Archetype

material_class.structural_family: decavanadate-type {Ce10O14} polyoxocerium core decorated by Mn

synthesis.procedure: Manganese isobutyrate (0.23 g, 1.0 mmol) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.21 g, 0.48 mmol) were dissolved in MeCN (10 mL), after which N-butyldiethanolamine (bda) (0.17 mL, 1.05 mmol) was added. The solution was heated at reflux for 1 h, filtered, and left in a covered vial. Light brown crystals of [Mn10O2(ib)18(Hib)2]·MeCN (1) formed after 1 d. When crystals of 1 were left in the reaction solution they dissolved completely after 3 d; after several weeks the solution produced dark brown crystals of 2. The crystals were washed with MeCN and dried in air. Formation of 1 and 2 requires bda; otherwise no products precipitate. The reaction proceeds in air (partial air oxidation of MnII).
synthesis.time: reflux 1 h; intermediate 1 after 1 d, redissolves after 3 d; 2 after several weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux, filtration, crystallization in a covered vial in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after reflux; sequential crystallization via intermediate 1; dark brown crystals of 2 isolated, washed with MeCN, dried in air

properties.summary: Main text does not discuss magnetic results; the supporting information presents magnetic data (together with TGA/DTA, BVS, and crystallographic details) for the compounds. Ce sites in 2 are all CeIV (diamagnetic), so magnetism is associated with the mixed-valent MnII/MnIII decoration (two MnII and six MnIII).

material_class.structural_family: decavanadate-type {Ce10O14} polyoxocerium core; two independent {Ce10Mn8} clusters differing in terminal H2O vs nPrOH ligands

synthesis.procedure: A solution of [Ce2(ib)6(H2O)3]n (0.10 g, 0.11 mmol) and manganese isobutyrate (0.11 g, 0.48 mmol) in n-propanol (5 mL) was heated at reflux for 2 h. The solution was filtered and left in a covered vial. Crystals of the known coordination polymer [Ce3(ib)9(nPrOH)4]n formed after 1 d; when left in the reaction solution they slowly redissolved, and after ten weeks dark brown crystals of 3 precipitated. The crystals were washed with nPrOH and dried in air.
synthesis.time: reflux 2 h; intermediate polymer after 1 d; 3 after ten weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux, filtration, crystallization in a covered vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after reflux; sequential crystallization via [Ce3(ib)9(nPrOH)4]n; dark brown crystals of 3 washed with nPrOH and dried in air

properties.summary: Main text does not discuss magnetic results; the supporting information presents magnetic data. Compound 3 contains two independent {CeIV10MnIII6MnII2O18} clusters that differ only in terminal H2O versus nPrOH ligands on Ce, so magnetism is likewise associated with the mixed-valent Mn decoration.
